title: First Greater After Updates
statement:
Use subtree maxima to find the first position in a range above a threshold after point assignments.

Input
n q, then n values. SET i x assigns a[i]=x. FIRST L R x queries an inclusive 1-based range.

Output
Print the smallest qualifying index, or 0 if every value in the range is at most x.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Thresholds and assigned values have the same bounds.
